name: Une chaine d'une infraction
source:
I have always dreamed of it. 
It's a dream of an unknown man staring at me from the darkness.
Pain and sorrow in his eyes don't allow me to avert gaze or run away.
He always asks me "Why"?
And I realize that I am sinful.
How can I pay for this sin?
I will carry this burden and search for redemption.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-april-2007-zwei-worter.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
我一直做着同一个梦。
那是一个陌生男人从黑暗中凝视着我的梦。
他眼中的痛苦和悲伤让我无法移开目光或逃跑。
他总是问我“为什么”？
而我意识到自己是有罪的。
我该如何赎罪？
我将背负这份重担，寻找救赎。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/05/vn-of-month-april-2007-zwei-worter.html]vndbreview[/url]]
